caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

VR headsets are master illusionists, tricking your brain into believing you're somewhere else entirely!

Here's the mind-bending science:
🔹 Each eye sees a subtly different 3D image.
🔹 Your brain naturally combines them to perceive depth.
🔹 Ultra-fast updates as you move fool your brain into presence.
